findings.title: The claimed synthesis/evidence/invalidation trace is a synthetic renderer fixture that the product projection cannot produce
findings.reproduction: At exact candidate 08e81290382d208f10c5f460dcd32296b8e6da53, inspect tests/service/test_provenance.py: its real SQLite/Core vertical writes only two revisions of one aggregate_kind='evidence'. canonical_aggregate_provenance_event always emits a succeeded org.research-observatory.<kind>.revision-recorded.v1 event with exactly one output and, only for the previous same aggregate, a wasDerivedFrom relation. _SqliteProvenanceLedgerRepository.lineage traverses only wasDerivedFrom and resolves each revision only from provenance_ledger_entities rows where direction='output'. Now construct the repository's own valid successful invalidation fixture through ProvenanceContractTests.invalidation_event('succeeded'): provenance_event_errors returns (), but the event has one input, zero outputs, and only wasInvalidatedBy plus wasAssociatedWith. It therefore cannot appear in this lineage projection. In contrast, AuditLineageWorkspace.test.tsx injects initialTrace directly into static rendering, invents an org.research-observatory.synthesis.invalidated.v1 node with output-style revision identity, and asserts the resulting substring label. The test never calls transport or performs navigation plus an exact-revision submission. No executable product test persists or queries the claimed synthesis.sentence -> evidence.passage branch, alternate branch, decision, or valid invalidation/stale fact. The evidence's end-to-end two-interaction, sampled branch, and invalidation claims are therefore unsupported, and an accepted valid invalidation remains invisible rather than visibly stale.
findings.required_remediation: Represent lineage and audit facts according to the portable relation semantics instead of coercing every fact into a producing-output node. Extend the bounded Core response as necessary with typed derivation, invalidation/staleness, decision, and supersession facts while retaining content minimization and read-only integrity-review behavior. Create valid portable synthesis/evidence/alternate/invalidation records through the governed T02 persistence authority, then prove the actual SQLite -> Core -> generated client -> interactive renderer path in navigation plus one exact-revision submission. The fixture must validate under the T01 contract; it must not model a successful invalidation as a newly generated output. Preserve prior/superseded/alternate facts visibly and add missing/legacy/integrity-review adverse cases against the real transport.

findings.title: The cross-process client and renderer do not enforce the exact pagination and depth authority of the trace request
findings.reproduction: At the exact candidate, call createCoreApiClient.lineage with cursor=0, pageSize=50, and maxDepth=8. Have a fake transport return the matching revisionId and direction, but 51 copies of one otherwise valid node at depth 9 and nextCursor=0. The independent Node 24 replay succeeds and prints 'accepted 51 max-depth 9 next 0'. decodeProvenanceLineagePage enforces only global maxima of 100 items and depth 16; lineage() then compares only revisionId and direction. It does not bind item count/depth/cursor progress/uniqueness to the request. In AuditLineageWorkspace, Load more uses trace.nextCursor but builds the request from the currently editable revisionId and direction, and appendPage checks only the response revision/direction before concatenating all items. Editing either form value after a trace can submit an old nonzero cursor against a new query and replace the display with a page lacking page zero/root; a repeated cursor can append the same page indefinitely because neither the client nor renderer requires progress or deduplicates node identities. This violates the approved strict bounded request/response and pagination boundary and can mislabel or grow an incoherent trace even though the honest Core implementation currently emits bounded pages.
findings.required_remediation: Make generated-client response validation request-aware: require items.length <= requested pageSize, every depth <= requested maxDepth, a contract-defined strictly advancing nextCursor consistent with the requested cursor/page, unique and deterministic node identities/order, and required root/page semantics. Freeze the accepted revision/direction/depth/page-size query with the displayed trace and use that authority for later pages; reject mismatches or non-progress, and merge without duplicates. Add fake-transport adversarial tests for over-page, over-depth, repeated/backward cursor, duplicate node, missing root, and query edits, plus real Core multi-page tests proving exact order, no skip/duplication, and termination.

findings.title: The React workspace omits mandatory regions from the approved Audit & Lineage page contract while evidence reports conformance
findings.reproduction: Compare the exact React component with approved reference RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.3 and the approved CAP-03.S03 slice plan. design/ui-reference/audit-lineage.html includes the content-minimized Export audit action, an Audit events region for security/rights/export/model/scholarly decisions, and output-identity facts for schema/model calls/human approvals/rights result/staleness. CAPABILITY_COVERAGE.md requires model/schema/prompt versions, rights and egress decisions, human decisions, audit events, and an exportable manifest; the slice plan names an Audit and Lineage workspace with export/redaction and requires access control/rights policy on exports. AuditLineageWorkspace.tsx implements only the exact-revision form, identity/completeness panels, one derivation table, and notices. It has no audit-event timeline/filter, rights or egress decision projection, human-decision region, export manifest action, redaction state, or export policy boundary. The evidence's passing ui_reference_check/ui_route_check/ui_accessibility_check commands report implementation_manifest=null and mode=approved-reference-application: they prove unchanged reference bytes, not conformance of this React page. The static renderer test asserts none of the missing governed regions or workflows.
findings.required_remediation: Implement the approved page's task-owned Audit & Lineage regions and interaction contracts, including content-minimized audit events, factual human and rights/egress decisions, and a governed redacted export manifest with service-level access/rights/integrity denial. Add an implementation conformance manifest or equivalent deterministic mapping from React regions/actions/states to the approved route/page/workflow contract, plus keyboard/focus/screen-reader and light/dark/responsive evidence for the actual app. If any approved region is intentionally assigned to later authority, record that consequential experience/scope change through the repository's governed amendment/reference path rather than claiming current conformance.
